Commentary.Commentary: Right then! Ben Stokes lifts the trophy along with his teammates and they go into the T20I series with a lot of confidence. There is a possibility that none of these players will be involved and they will be playing a full-strength squad, pending a negative Covid-test. Pakistan, on the other hand, have a lot of thinking to do before the T20Is. The T20I series will begin on 16th July at 1830 local (1730 GMT). Do join just then. Cheers and take care.

Ben Stokes, the England skipper, comes up for a chat. He says that he thinks that they have been brilliant throughout the series and the guys have been fantastic. Adds that he is thankful to all involved for pulling this series off despite the difficulties. Goes onto say that credit has to go to Eoin Morgan, Chris Silverwood and Trevor Bayliss for making the team that it is. Says that this is the culture that they have created which is to allow the players to play freely, enjoy themselves and it was fun to play in front of the crowd of Edgbaston. Goes onto say that they have some good players coming through and he is impressed with everyone. Tells that Bob Willis was one of the greats of the game and they are doing a good thing with Bob Willis foundation.

Babar Azam, the Pakistan skipper, is up for a chat. He says that they had a good time with the bat but they did not bowl well and their fielding was poor. Adds that Vince played brilliantly and credits England for chasing down this total. States that they did not bowl in the right channels and they dropped too many catches and that is where they lost the game. Adds that they will try to rectify the mistakes in the T20Is.

Saqib Mahmood, the PLAYER OF THE SERIES, says they had a pretty special week and he is very happy to have repaid the faith. Goes onto say that he tried to out the ball in the right areas and it worked. Goes onto say that Stokes has carried on from Morgan. Tells that he will take each day as it comes.

James Vince, the PLAYER OF THE MATCH, says that they got off to a quick start and the run rate never went out of control. Adds that Lewis Gregory came out and released the pressure. States that they managed to pick up boundaries regularly and were also able to knock the ball around. Is pleased to make a contribution and he enjoyed himself out there.
Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony!!!

Where did Pakistan lose this game? All I can say is their fielding. They had many chances to send Stokes out but did not make use of the opportunities but their ground fielding was poor as they misfielded a lot and gave away too many extra runs in the field. Now with the ball in hand, Shaheen Afridi had a tough day while, Hasan Ali started well but could not keep up the pressure. Shadab Khan had a good game while Haris Rauf took his career-best figures. One might feel, that if Pakistan held onto their catches and their ground fielding was better, things might have been different.

England were off to a terrific start as Philip Salt gave them a blistering start but Malan fell for a duck and then Salt, after hitting a few more lusty blows, departed. Zak Crawley looked good before he was dismissed while Ben Stokes did not make use of the opportunities he got. They were half down for 165 and it looked like Pakistan will get their first win but James Vince and Lewis Gregory had other plans. They stitched a magnificent partnership with Vince scoring his maiden ODI century and Gregory playing a fine knock. But when they departed in quick succession, England went on the back foot. Craig Overton and Brydon Carse held their nerves and took England home.

End of an excellent match for England! James Vince, Lewis Gregory and Craig Overton, take a bow! You have completed a heist and have helped England chase down 332 and whitewash Pakistan. Brydon Carse was good too with the bat. Pakistan would be really disappointed with the effort as they had a good chance of winning their first game but it was not to be.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND!  Well third time lucky for Shadab and Pakistan! They finally manage to dislodge Stokes. Flashback Perth, 2013. Ben Stokes was playing his second Test and it was the Ashes, Down Under, in Perth. It was a phenomenal example of keeping then. It is a phenomenal example of keeping now. We shall describe this one first. It was the googly, outside off and Stokes looked to play the slog sweep. But all he managed was an under edge. Mohammad Rizwan showed excellent reflexes to take the catch and Stokes has to go! In Perth it was Brad Haddin the keeper and Nathan Lyon the bowler. Both occasions had one thing in common - the ball going away from Stokes as he was attempting a slog sweep. Pakistan should be favourites now. England need 181 to win from 180 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! ADMONISHED! Neither Hasan Ali nor Sohaib Maqsood would be happy right now. Both gave a life to Stokes and he is making merry now. Dropped way too short, outside off, the skipper goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket!
Short, outside off, the skipper goes back and punches it towards mid off.

There comes the reverse sweep again, this time the connection is made and it goes towards short third man. Faheem Ashraf dives to his left from short third man but it is not a clean stop. Two runs taken.
Shorter, around off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Full, around middle, Ben Stokes looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the body.
Around off, pushed towards short mid-wicket

FOUR! Away behind square on the off side. That is a James Vince special, really. Finesse, caress, timing. All three were visible in this stroke. Back of a length, outside off, Vince goes back and transfers his weight onto that shot. The ball rockets behind point and beats Shaheen Afridi's desperate dive to his right from third man.
Outside off, James Vince punches it straight to short extra cover where we see another fumble. No run taken.
Around middle and leg, Stokes tucks it through mid-wicket for a single. England need another 193 from 189 balls.
Short ball, outside leg, following Ben Stokes, who is backing away, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, defended watchfully.

DROPPED, FOUR! No, Pakistan! What are you doing? Second life for Ben Stokes in the span of 9 balls. Full, around middle, Stokes comes down the track and swings it towards long on. Now, Sohaib Maqsood is stationed there, but for some reason, he is standing a few yards inside the boundary ropes. The ball comes to him but he has to leap. Sticks out his right hand, but the ball bursts through and reaches the ropes. Had he been at the ropes, Stokes would have gone past the ropes to the dressing room.
Fuller, around off, James Vince reaches out and pushes this towards long off for a single. England need another 199 from 197 balls.

FOUR! WHOOSH! Stokes is probably deciding to take matters in his own hands. A length ball, around middle, the skipper comes down the track and hammers it to the right of mid off. The fielder slides over the ball and it goes through.
Back of a length, around off, angling away, BS punches it towards cover.
On a length, around middle again, defended back down the track.
Down the track again, is the skipper and he pulls this through mid-wicket for a couple.

Faheem Ashraf gets a change of ends. 1-0-9-0 so far.

It is the longer part of the ground though and Hasan Ali actually does well to run long to his right from fine leg. They need more than 200 runs at a shade over 6 an over and it is going to be really challenging. The pitch is slowing down and now, it will be interesting to see how the spinners fare. And talking about spin, here he comes - SHADAB KHAN.

MATCH UPDATE - Holy me! IRELAND HAVE DEFEATED SOUTH AFRICA by 43 runs in Dublin! Who saw this coming? Well, this is a big shocker. The Proteas dropped plenty of catches and allowed the Irish to get to 290/5, which turned out to be very big for the visitors! Andy Balbirnie was the star for the home side with a fine 102.

POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

FOUR! WHAM! Fine way to end Powerplay 1. A short ball, around the hips, Crawley stands on one leg, swivels like a pivot, or a hinge rather and pulls it behind square leg. One bounce and into the fence. England end Powerplay 1 on 84/2, while Pakistan were 35/1 at the same stage!
Around middle and off, Zak Crawley flicks this straight to square leg.
This time he turns it quietly around the corner, towards square leg, for a single.
Oohhh... full, outside off, angling away, James throws the kitchen sink at this one but misses.

What happened? The keeper, Mohammad Rizwan is looking at the fielder in disgust, after that ball. The ball had gone to mid on and the fielder returned a rocket throw to the keeper who was visibly not happy.
Around off, coming in, James Vince pushes this towards mid on.
Outside off, on a length, Vince just blasts this on the up, without even moving his feet. The ball rockets away. That is how good the pitch is. But the ball is intercepted at cover.
Second attempt. Blown away by Salt in the first attempt. Let's have another try shall we, from the other end? Might get some sugar now. Here's Shaheen Afridi. 3-0-31-0 so far.
Fuller, around off, pushed straight to mid on.
FOUR! Short outside off, but some width as well. Crawley lashes it behind point and beats third man to his right.
On a length, outside off, Zak defends it to the off side.
Outside off, this is played on the up, driven, but straight to cover. England need another 257 from 249 balls.
Around off, whipped through mid-wicket for a couple.
Around off, on a length, James Vince dabs it to the leg side and takes a quick single. The stand moves to 20 from 12 balls. England need another 259 from 251 balls.

FOUR! Stand and deliver! Whether Hasan Ali goes or not, this one has to go. Fractionally short outside off, Crawley just stands his ground and whips a pull over wide mid on. 10 from the over, Hasan Ali's figures read 4-0-31-1.
Problems for Pakistan? Hasan Ali has been stretching his groin for the last three balls in a row now. He is almost limping and one feels that after this next ball, he will go off.
Fuller, outside off, Crawley drives it straight to cover.

Driven on the up. This is such a lovely pitch. JV comes forward and drives this on the up through the covers. Fakhar Zaman we think it is, from that position, runs after the ball, gets to it, slides and then pulls it back to his partner who is running after him from mid off. Three runs taken.
On a length, outside off, James pushes it towards point.
WIDE. Full, down the leg side, Vince misses his flick.
Change in the field now. Second slip moves out now, to reinforce the covers.

Another piece of misfielding. Full, outside off, James Vince drives it through the covers where the fielder well, just dives over the ball and it goes through. Two runs taken. England need another 268 from 256 balls.
Around off, watchfully defended.

What is happening? We saw this in the second ODI as well. Mohammad Rizwan has rushed off to the toilet and Sarfaraz Ahmed has come in as his substitute. Oh okay, Rizwan is back and Sarfaraz rushes back with a big smile on his face. The game was stalled for some time.
FOUR MORE! Outstanding timing. A length ball again, a bit too straight, Zak Crawley works it through mid-wicket and the ball races away! Crawley has raced to 20 from 17 balls.

FOUR! ELEGANT! A tall player, who plays beautiful, crisp drives, Zak Crawley is a treat to watch. Length ball, around off, Crawley drives it straight back to where it came from, past the bowler, down the ground.
This one comes in too, Crawley looks to tuck it to the leg side but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Around off, coming in, nudged straight to short mid-wicket.
Off the mark straightaway, Vince steers it to third man for a single.
James Vince walks in at number 4, replacing Philip Salt.

OUT! CAUGHT! Haris Rauf has struck on his very first ball! He is all over the moon and Salt takes the long walk back to the pavillion. Nothing special about the delivery, nothing too good or bad about the shot and nothing too difficult about the catch. Just like any normal day in our lives, this one comes just like that. It is a length ball, around off and Philip Salt just looked to whip it away. Nothing wrong with that. But just that the flight of the ball was obstructed by Fakhar Zaman at short mid-wicket! Did not have to move an inch. But a metre either side of him and it was a boundary. End of an entertaining innings from Salt but England need a partnership now. 279 needed from 263 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Fakhar Zaman b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Haris Rauf comes on to bowl now.

Chipped over mid on. A length ball, around middle, Zak Crawley looks to hit this over the top but the ball stops a bit on the surface. Hence, the shot is through before the ball can come and it lobs off the face of the bat. But it lobs over mid on and the batsmen take a couple. England need another 279 from 264 balls.
Three in a row to cover! Zak is simply not able to find that gap. Length ball outside off, ZC leans and drives but finds cover once again.
Fuller length, outside off, Crawley punches on the up but finds cover.
Outside off, on a length, driven straight to cover.

MISFIELD. Pakistan have been ragged on the field, alright. Full, outside off, Philip Salt drives it towards we think it is Saud Shakeel at short extra cover. However, he fumbles and the ball goes through. The batsmen take one and Salt is desperate to come back for the second. But Crawley sends him back.

Full, outside off, swinging away, Zak Crawley drives away from his body and gets a thick outside edge towards third man. A single is taken and 50 IS UP FOR ENGLAND! They need another 282 from 269 balls. Crawley moves to 10 from 9 balls.
Short ball on middle, Salt pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple to end the over.

FOUR! Loose delivery from Afridi especially with the fine leg fielder up. Short down the leg side, All Salt has to do is to get some bat on it which he does and it goes to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Short ball outside off, Salt looks to pull but misses. Afridi has a stare at Salt after that, Salt tells him to go back to his run up.
Low full toss on middle, Salt drives it back to the bowler. Afridi gets a hand to it before it rolls to mid on.
Good length ball on off, Salt pushes it to cover.
Good length ball outside off, Crawley guides it to third man for one.
Good length ball outside off, Salt slashes it to third man where the fielder fumbles a bit and allows the batters to take a single.
FOUR! Edged but Salt will take it! Back of a length ball outside off, Salt looks to cut but gets an outside edge and it flies to third man for a boundary.
On a length on middle, Salt plays it to mid on.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! This is not good fielding from Pakistan and free runs for England. Good length ball on middle, Salt works it to mid-wicket. Crawley looks for the single but is sent back. Saud Shakeel collects and has a shy at the bowler's end and hits. It ricochets and goes past the extra cover fielder for a four overthrows.
Good length ball outside off, Salt looks to play the cut shot but fails to get any bat on it..
Length ball on off, Salt defends it to point.
Good length ball on off, Crawley looks to defend but gets an outside off and it goes to third man. Crawley wants two and takes off, makes it easily.
FOUR! No need to run for that as that has been timed superbly. Afridi goes full again on off, Crawley drives it through the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Crawley pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball on off, Zak Crawley defends it to cover and shouts a loud no for the single.
Lovely shot but for nothing! Fullish ball on off, Crawley creams the drive but straight to the mid off fielder.
Crawley is off the mark! Good length ball on off, Crawley drives it through mid off and picks up a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
A successful over from Hasan Ali comes to an end. He bowls a good length ball on middle, Salt defends it out onto the pitch.
Fullish ball on off, Philip pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Salt will continue on his merry way! Good length ball outside off, Salt drives it uppishly but wide the point fielder for a boundary.
LEG BYE! Good length ball on the pads, Crawley looks to flick but it goes off the pads to the leg side for a leg bye.
Much like the second ODI, Zak Crawley is in early at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a ball from Hasan Ali and Dawid Malan goes for a duck again! He did not get a run in the second ODI and now falls for a duck. Pakistan needed this as they were put under the pump by Philip Salt in the first over and they will be pleased with this. Hasan runs in and bowls a length ball around off, angles it across. Malan looks to flick but gets an outside edge to Rizwan who takes the catch. Pakistan appeal and up goes the finger. 313 needed in 292 balls. Well, well, had Malan reviewed that, he would have been safe as the Ultra Edge shows no spike. This is the second time in this game that England have missed an opportunity.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Hasan Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Much better from Hasan! He finally gets his line right. Good length ball outside off, Malan shoulders arms to it.
WIDE! Make it three in a row! This time, Hasan bowls it outside the tramline outside off, Malan has no problems in leaving it alone.
WIDE! Another one! Hasan Ali has not got his radar correct so far. Good length ball down the leg side. Malan misses his flick. Wide given.
WIDE! Loosener to start from Hasan Ali! He bowls one down the leg side, Malan looks to flick but misses. Rizwan dives to his right to make the stop. Wide.
Hasan Ali to bowl with the second new ball.
FOUR! What a start from Philip Salt! 16 runs from the first over and England are off. Fullish and outside off, Salt lifts it over the cover fielder for another boundary.

FOUR! This is the best of the lot! Outstanding batting from Salt. Afridi is looking for some swing but he is finding only the middle part of the bat. Another full on off, Salt prods and drives it towards long off. The fielder gives it a chase but in vain as it touches the ropes.
FOUR! Powerful shot from Philip Salt! He is off to a good start here. Not a bad ball from Afridi but a very good shot. Full on off and middle, Salt lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
Driven very firmly but for a dot. Full on middle, Salt drives it back to the bowler. Afridi bends down, gets a hand to it and then it rolls to mid on.
FOUR! That is some way to get off the mark from Philip Salt! Afridi overpitches it outside off, Salt opens the face of the bat and then drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Afridi starts with a full toss on off, Salt misses out on some runs here as he just pushes it down to mid off.
